nom: HERBIVORE PINK CLOUD Rosewater + Tremella Creamy Jelly Cleanser

avis.titre: Always go back to this one
avis.texte: Ive used this cleanser for years on/off and its always worked and made my skin feel clean without being stripped. Used it since high school and even now in mid twenties!
I'm thrilled that Herbivore has come to Ulta! This is my all time favorite cleanser. It's gentle, but does its job. Plus- I love supporting a local woman-owned brand.
Perfect cleanser for my skin. Is super gentle, so my skin doesn't get too dry. Also easily removes my makeup!
I love this cleanser as someone who has dry and sensitive skin.

I'm an older gal, and my skin is going crazy from hormonal. But mostly my skin is tend to get dryer as I get older. I have tried so many facial cleanser from natural to clinical, but nothing.. nothing can come close to Pink Cloud! I love that it's actually clean my skin from sunscreen - I don't wear makeups, and it's also doesn't dry out my skin after wash. Doesn't cause any acnes or comedos. Please do not discontinued this EVER!

My skin tends to be on the dry side in many spots and I have trouble finding a clean product that truly cleans my face without making it feel dry. PINK CLOUD Rosewater + Tremella Creamy Jelly Cleanser really does feel like a cloud when you apply it to your face. The smell is also fantastic. Highly recommend!
I was introduced to your product by a daughter in law few years ago and have used it ever since . I have sensitive skin and love this cleanser .
Love this cleanser! Always feel clean and refreshed after washing my face!
The is so gentle and yet removes my waterproof mascara. Truly an amazing product can't say enough!!!
Really enjoying this gentle cleanser! Feels like it gets the job done, my only complaint is that it didn't fully remove makeup.

love this TREMELLA Silky Hydration Gel Cream, it is very nice and hydrated under makeup and love love the texture of it. my skin looks so healthy. great for this weather gifted by herbivore botanicals

I couldn't love this cleanser more. It is dental enough to remove eye makeup and not hurt my eyes. It removes makeup well and smells nice. This is a staple product and I will never look for another cleanser!

This is the best stuff my sensitive combination skin has ever used. I was hospitalized for three months and the staff had machines that dried my skin and made pores in them. This has been the only thing that has minimized the pores while both hydrating and balancing my skins complexion. Its gentle, smells great, feels silky and smooth and is pretty to look at. I have the emerald oil that I plan on using with a Gua Sha tool for maximum product absorption. Can't wait! Thank you for making such a beautiful face wash. Please never change or discontinue this!
The cleanser is so light and smells fabulous! Great after a long day and you want something soothing and soft for your face!

This is my favorite jelly cleanser. It takes off all my make up and leaves my skin feeling refreshed, moistized and so soft. I asked for it for my birthday and ordered 2 bottles so I would have one extra but I ended up giving one bottle to my mother and she absolutely loves it as well. Its fantastic.

I use this cleanser in tandem with their other Aquarius cleanser (I'm a double-cleanse girly, iykyk) and it works like a dream! Pink Cloud to remove makeup (gentle for eye makeup too!) and after, the Aquarius for a deep-pore cleanse/gentle exfoliation. On the days where I'm not wearing makeup and just their Star Seed sunscreen, I'll use the pink cloud cleanser only. This has been my go-to routine for a while now and I finally feel like I've perfected my skincare— less is more. And gentle, CLEAN products are key!
I absolutely love this cleanser! My sensitive skin is thriving using this. I will never use anything else.

i've been using this for about a year now and it's really the only face wash that doesn't make my skin irritated. it's a softer cleanser, but still leaves my skin feeling fresh. love this would for sure recommend.
I love this cleanser. My face feels clean without stripping my natural oils. Clean ingredients equals clean skin ✨️
I really enjoy how soft this cleanser makes my face feel. Clean, but moisturized. Very nice scent too!
Calming to my sensitive skin and seems to calm the redness. Good makeup remover too.

This stuff is magic. I've been struggling to find a skincare that works for me ever since Arbonne discontinued the AgeWell line. I have very dry and sensitive skin and have tried so many duds (including the trending tallow moisturizer which did not work for me so that's why I know my skin is a herbivore lol). I stumbled across this brand when I saw their products were breastfeeding safe but still had resurfacing power. My line up is the Pink Cloud Cleanser, Bakuchiol, Pink Cloud Moisturizer, and Orchid Oil for day and Emerald Oil at night. Got my mom hooked on it as well. SO GOOD
I have been using the pink cloud moisturizer fir several years and I love it. Don't know why I didn't try it before!
I love this cleanser and have been using it for about 2 years now. It helps my face to always feel and look refreshed.

I've been using this cleanser consistently for a few years now and it's by far my favorite. I have tried other cleansers both from Herbivore and other brands, but what I love about this one is how gentle it is. I have normal skin and this has always been perfect to easily remove makeup and excess oils if I'm fresh out of the gym or if I've been cooking a lot in my commercial kitchen. It has never irritated my skin, it's kept my face well balanced for years, and I usually take a travel sized with me if I'm away from home for more than a few days. I would absolutely recommend this to any of my friends!

I've been struggling with acne for years and this seems to be the only face wash that really works with my face. Great product and I would definitely recommend if you are looking for a less harsh face wash.
Best facial cleanser! I have very dry skin and this does not dry out my face and cleanses it thoroughly. I've been using it for years now, a forever favorite.

Great cleanser for my sensitive skin. It is not drying and not irritating at all. I usually leave it on a couple minutes before rinsing and really seems to take care of my skin. The fragrance is a bit off-putting at first (very earthy) but like it so much better than others for its clean and natural ingredients.
it feels so lovely and cleansing, not abrasive at all. and lasts foreverrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr
I absolutely love this cleanser. It's great for my sensitive skin, and is not overwhelmingly fragrant.

I just started using this cleanser and it's a game changer! It's so gentle without stripping your skin. You can see and feel this level of clean! I can't help but keep running my hands over my face after because it's so soft!! This is a must have in your routine! I love your products so much herbivore, you've been in my life for almost 6 years and there isn't one product I've disliked! Cheers!

I got this on sale after almost getting it for a long time. I didn't have high hopes, only because I didn't want to be disappointed like I usually am after big claims on a face cleanser don't pan out. I've been using oil cleansers for a long time, and add a double cleanse when my mascara doesn't come off, which is usually 50% of the time. I named this review title, "Wait, what?" because it's STILL my reaction after using just ONE squirt of this stuff and it somehow gets all of my makeup washed away with no hassle and no second steps. I will continue purchasing this product and I would be willing to pay full price for it now that I know it works. If you're on the fence, give it a shot! I have pretty sensitive skin and this cleanser has not upset it at all.
I've tried several clean cleanser options and always come back to this one! Gentle, yet effective- my sensitive skin is happy and the scent isn't overpowering.

avis.titre: Cleanses gently & thoroughly, taking makeup with it.
avis.texte: Finally, one cleanser! Morning AND night. Don't need to use a separate makeup remover either. One squirt only, so it lasts a long while. Love it.
I like this cleanser. It's really creamy and doesn't strip my skin. Only need 1 pump to clean my whole face and neck.

This is literally my holy grail! I started using this cleanser at the beginning of covid when maskne hit hard. I've tried many different cleansers before and since just to see what's out there, and everything else seems to dry out and irritate my sensitive combination skin. Not this one, though! I use this cleanser morning and night, and it leaves my skin feeling so soft and never stripped, even when I use retinoids. The redness in my skin is evened out and the maskne is gone! Please never stop making this!
Very high quality and very lovely to wash my face with. Love!
I used this a few years back and switched to something else. Decided to come back to this recently and am so glad I did. Leaves my skin feeling hydrated and not dry after washing. Highly recommend!
Best facial cleanser ever!! Love how fresh and clean my face feels while feel supple and dewy. Never feels like any residue stays behind!
Best cleanser ever! I've been using this for almost a year and this has controlled my skin so well! It cleans and keeps it looking fresh. Just use it consistently to see results
Perfect cleanser - light and refreshing way to cleanse my skin!
i've been using this cleanser for some time—love it and keep coming back!
I have never had a cleanser so moisturizing but also made my skin feel so clean. It feels so luxurious!
I have dry skin & I really appreciate how Pink Cloud cleanser removes all daily makeup and dirt from the day without drying my skin out. I never have that"taut" feeling
A good daily wash, my skin is doing well with it, it's been a little over a week of using. I don't feel dried out after washing.
This is the BEST facial cleanser I hav e. Ever used "Simply said ". My face is throughly and comfortably cleansed.

avis.titre: Use every evening in the shower
avis.texte: Love the way a small drop of this silky cleanser works into a lovely lather. Washes away all traces of the day. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and smooth.
I like the gentleness of this cleanser and also its effectiveness! Great product and not too much fragrance!
Hard to find gentle makeup removal products and this is just as gentle as I need it to be with sensitive skin and gets the job done!
I love this cleanser when I just want a nice, clean face without having to worry about targeting any skin concerns.
The cleanser was not harsh and left my skin feeling soft and moist.
Love this cleanser! Feels so refreshing and cleans my skin so well! Not irritating at all on my sensitive and a new prone skin!

avis.titre: Dry skin people … THE BEST CLEANSER I HAVE EVER USED!
avis.texte: My face is always on the dry side and even more dry in the winter months. I struggle to keep it as hydrated as possible. I have tried so many products it's unbelievable. After using this cleanser for the first time I couldn't believe how perfect it was for everything I needed. A cleanser that lathers so well only using one pump, washing away makeup and impurities, while also keeping my face feeling hydrated even after I wash off. This cleanser feels so nice like a foaming creamy, jelly texture. I love the deep clean and hydrating feeling it gives my skin. Using only one pump and emulsifying in my hands before I apply to my face makes the bottle last a long time! I could go on and on, lol. Thank you !!
I understand the name Pink Cloud, it is a very lightweight cleanser. Not heavy at all and rinses off beautifully.
Love this cleanser. Glad to get a large size at a good deal because I use this morning and night.

Love this cleanser!!!! It replenishes my dehydrated, sensitive, and acne-prone skin. My skin has recovered from retinoid and benzyl peroxide induced dryness and irritation. It has a nice rose fragrance and I love the glass bottle design. Definitely recommend this cleanser!!!
I really love this cleanser. I use this cleanser with my Foreo Luna every morning and night and my skin does not dry out. I haven't had any reactions or breakouts either.

I've been using this cleanser consistently for over a year and I absolutely love it. I am so glad that there is a larger bottle of it now! This is the only thing I will use to remove my makeup since it is so effective but not drying at all.
Feels very nice and slippy on the skin, reducing any rubbing friction which is good. Foams well and cleans off my daily sunscreen well. Smells great!
Its amazing! So soft and foams very well! I have dry sensitive skin and my skin doesn't feel stripped after washing💕💕 love this cleanser

This is the perfect cleanser for my dry, sensitive skin. It foams lightly, gets every last bit of makeup off, and doesn't leave my skin tight. There is no detectable scent which I appreciate and a little goes a long way. One pea-sized pump is all you need. I cant imagine finding anything better.
This is the best cleanser I have ever used. I have dry skin so this keeps my face very moisturized after washing my face and keeps everything clear.
Removes makeup so well and leaves your face feeling soft and clean. Love this cleanser
This is my go-to cleanser. It is so gentle and truly removes all of my makeup at the end of the day. I don't let myself run out of this product.

Pink cloud is now my go to: the cleanser is perfect. It cleans so effectively and leaves my skin hydrated and soft. I'm over 50 and having a cleanser that leaves my dry skin supple is vital. I'm on the pink cloud bus with the moisturizer and serum as well. Great job Herbivore!
I love this cleanser! It's cleansing and balancing without drying out my skin or leaving a film.
I cannot say enough good things about this cleanser! The minute you start rubbing it on your face you know it's gonna be gentle. I can feel the difference and feel that it's not stripping my skin

avis.titre: Non irritating and gets all the makeup off
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin and after going back and forth a few times with other brands, this is now my holy grail cleanser. It gets all my makeup off without making my skin red or inflamed. It also doesn't give my skin that 'tight' feeling which I learned is actually bad! I wish it was less pricy, but I'm willing to pay for it anyway so joke's on me I guess.
I keep coming back to this one. Nothing cleans as well and gently on my sensitive dry skin. LOVE IT.

I have very sensitive skin so most cleansers dry it out unfortunately. This one is very gentle, like the Curology cleanser and doesn't dry out my skin too bad. I repurchased once the first one ran out and I'm pretty happy. I also love that it comes in glass packaging and no longer has a plastic sticker on the bottle. However I'm giving the product 4 stars because I bought it for the glass bottle originally and I just discovered that the paper box it comes in is not recyclable because it has a plastic film on it to keep the box matte. I u detest and that it may be that way because the brand wants to give people a light and fluffy feel, but I think the product speaks for itself and there could be a soft box that is not covered in a plastic film that the majority of recycling centers don't have the equipment to be able to process. I'm seeing good progress and I like this cleanser a lot so I hope that is something that Herbivore can look into and consider changing. Otherwise I might not repurchase..

I appreciate a homegrown business that aims to make products that are safer for the earth and its inhabitants. I love the idea of cleaning my face with mushrooms, instead of chemicals, about which we know little. This cleanser feels good going on and appears to "take off the day" effectively. (My skin is older, formerly peaches-and-cream fair, and suffering from a lifetime of abuse and neglect.) I've been using this along with the Pink Cloud moisturizer, Cloud Jelly, and Phoenix oil…religiously now that it's too late 😝 My hairdresser said my face must be well hydrated since the deep purple dye came off my hairline so easily. I like how my skin looks and feels. The packaging and glass bottles it comes in are beautiful. All of which is feel-good. Are these potions really improving my skin or changing the rate at which it will continue aging? Seems unlikely. But my skin is undeniably clearer, cleaner, and softer a year or so later—something I was never been able to say with the various department store regimes I've (sort of) tried. Should women need four different, expensive, products to make our faces socially acceptable? No. Then to cover it in makeup products before we dare leave the house? Only if we continue believing the billion dollar Big Beauty scam. But for those privileged enough, good skin care is a good thing, and Herbivore is a smaller, local company (for me) that has organized itself around making products that are both less harmful and feel good, which I apprecia
This gentle face cleanser leaves your skin feeling soft and will not strip your face!

This a really good jelly cleanser. It does its job and after cleansing skin does not feel tight and dry. I do double cleansing so I cannot say how it will be if I jut this cleanser alone. I gave 4 star because , I was getting mild rash on my face and still think Cetaphil cleanser is superior in qality this cleanser
I love the way it feels on my face & how it suds up with very little amount. It doesn't make my skin feel dry or stiff like. I do like this product a lot!!

I really really love this product. I love the way that it bubbles up, glides on smoothly to my face and also leaves my face feeling super clean. It really does feel like rubbing a cloud on my face. Will definitely buy again!
I love this cleanser and how it makes my skin feel. It is light, gentle on sensitive skin, refreshing and hydrating!
This cleanser is fantastic, it is gentle, nice foam and leaves skin clean and soft I have been using for over a year and have noticed good results . highly recommend
I've been using this in the evenings after I oil cleanse. It's good at cleansing, but the smell is a little too funky for my liking. Other than that it's a gentle but effective cleanser :)
Love this cleanser! It is so silky and moisturizing. I only need half a pump, a little goes a long way.
This was my second purchase of Pink Cloud cleanser. I'm so happy with this product. My skin is really sensitive, finding the perfect cleaner has been quite the journey!
This is my third time buying this cleanser, I love it so much! It's lightweight and doesn't dry my face out at all, which I love.
I've been using this product for years now and I absolutely love it, best face wash I've ever had. It plumps up my skin with hydration, and it fights break-outs at the same time.

I bought this in a kit and had never used the brand before. I'm one of those people where once I find a brand, it sticks. I'd been using another for probably 10 years. This is my new one! The cleanser is so gentle and feels refreshing. Removes make up as well. My only complaint (maybe it was defective) - is that the pump pushes out a lot more product than needed. Almost four times the amount I need. Not sure if it's a design flaw or the one I got specifically is defective. But a little bit goes a long way and I'll be sticking to this brand and looking to try more of their products! :)

avis.titre: Best face wash without drying out your face
avis.texte: My skin has its own mood throughout the day, however with this wash I have be able to keep my cleanse my fave without drying it out. The best wash I have ever experienced!
This is easily the best face wash I've ever used. There is nothing like it out there. You will not be disappointed. It feels amazing, cleanses, and doesn't dry your skin.
This is the best cleanser I've used! It's really gentle and hydrating and removes mascara.

The only cleanser I've tried that consistently removes my makeup, doesn't dry my skin, and doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts. I will never use another cleanser. One pump on a silicone facial scrubber and it will last months!
A little goes a long way! This lathers well and doesn't strip my skin of moisture. It's creamy, doesn't have an overpowering smell and makes my skin feel clean!

I have been looking for a gentle product with tremella mushroom to improve hydration. So glad I went w this one. I feel it deeply cleans my face, removes makeup, without drying me out, leaves skin soft and supple. (Skin type is normal and prone to being dehydrated)
My face feels smooth and clean and it removed my eye makeup no problem. Love it

I love this cleanser! It's so light and delicate that at first I thought no way this is actually cleaning my skin. But my skin loves it! I have sensitive skin and can break out very easily with certain products but this has been a favorite, it feels so nice and my skin is clear and smooth. I use this with the nova vit C serum and the lapis face oil. It's a perfect combination for me.
I love the Pink Cloud cleanser. It feels great on the skin and make my skin clean and soft.
I really like this cleanser. It helps remove make-up and does not feel like it dries out my skin.

I have such sensitive skin when it comes to using certain products. They make my face itch and burn so bad, but then I came across this! I looooovvveeee this cleanser. It cleans my face well, has a nice texture, and doesnt leave my face feeling dry or red. Definitely using this forEVER. ❤️❤️
I've been using this product for about a month now and my skin feels so soft, hydrated, and looks & feels smooth.
This is the best cleanser I have used. I bought it in January and the larger bottle lasted me six months. It's creamy and cleanses well without drying my skin.
Pink Cloud has been my ride-or-die face wash for the past several years. The only facewash I've ever used that is able to *actually* get eye makeup off without leaving my face greasy or drying.

I love the texture of this face wash. It's smooth and almost gel-like and then, kind of surprisingly, lathers beautifully. The smell is fine for me although I'm sure someone attached to flowery smells might find it slightly off-putting. As someone who lives in Hawaii it has a faint hint of noni scent which is a bit pungent but medicinal so I associate it with good stuff. When I'm finished washing my face always feels clean but hydrated still, which is my end goal.
